data.description:
## Observation
A local `make verify` (worktree w1-koala-goose, test-only change to test_mcp_opcert_signing_goose.py; host running 3 concurrent verifies, wall time 1:49:19) failed `tests/interfaces/store/test_repair_pause_ownership_store.py::test_in_flight_refusal_clears_owned_pause_before_mutation[doctor]`: `RefLockTimeoutError: git update-ref refs/reconciler/gate timed out after 5.0s (fail-closed: treat as HELD)`, re-raised as `RepairPauseError: a reconciler pass is in flight`. The suite had 1 failed, 21561 passed. The module then passed 3 times in isolation on the same host (30 passed each, 58 s, 131 s, 135 s).

## Hypothesis (unproven)
Same class as closed ticket sensible-curt-acouchi: the test fails whenever one local `git update-ref` in its temp repo exceeds `_ref_lock._LOCAL_TIMEOUT_SECS` (5.0 s), which host load can cause. Not yet reproduced deterministically with a delaying git shim for this test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The failure is reproduced deterministically (e.g. a git shim delaying update-ref past 5 s) and the root cause recorded.
- [ ] The test no longer fails under that reproduction, or the bug is closed with the evidence-backed disposition.
data.title: Repair-pause in-flight test fails when a git update-ref in its temp repo exceeds the 5-second ref-lock bound under host load
